WITH baseline_daily AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
  GROUP BY 1
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(cnt) AS baseline_avg,
    stddev_pop(cnt) AS baseline_spread,
    SUM(cnt) AS n_baseline
  FROM baseline_daily
),
window_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS value,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
)
SELECT
  wa.value,
  ROUND(bs.baseline_avg, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(bs.baseline_spread, 4) AS spread,
  wa.n,
  bs.n_baseline
FROM window_agg wa, baseline_stats bs;
